tasks.subject: Task 1: Project scaffold
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A working Vite + React + TypeScript + Vitest project that builds and has one passing test.

**Files:**
- Create: package.json, tsconfig.json, vite.config.ts, index.html, src/main.tsx, src/setupTests.ts, src/index.css, src/App.tsx
- Test: src/App.test.tsx
- Modify: .gitignore

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] npm run build succeeds and produces dist/
- [ ] npm test passes

**Verify:** npm test -> 1 passed; npm run build -> exits 0

```json:metadata
{"files": ["package.json", "tsconfig.json", "vite.config.ts", "index.html", "src/main.tsx", "src/setupTests.ts", "src/index.css", "src/App.tsx", "src/App.test.tsx", ".gitignore"], "verifyCommand": "npm test && npm run build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["npm run build succeeds", "npm test passes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Port question and choice data
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The real 120-item IPIP-NEO question bank and 5-point Likert choice set, typed and verified for integrity.

**Files:**
- Create: src/lib/types.ts, src/data/questions.ts, src/data/choices.ts, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
- Test: src/data/questions.test.ts, src/data/choices.test.ts

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] 120 items, 24 per domain, unique ids
- [ ] choices has plus (1-5) and minus (5-1)
- [ ] Attribution recorded

**Verify:** npm test -> all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/types.ts", "src/data/questions.ts", "src/data/choices.ts", "src/data/questions.test.ts", "src/data/choices.test.ts", "THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md"], "verifyCommand": "npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["120 questions, 24 per domain, unique ids", "choices plus/minus correct", "attribution recorded"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Scoring logic
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Compute per-domain average, 0-100 normalized score, and high/neutral/low classification from answers.

**Files:**
- Create: src/lib/scoring.ts
- Test: src/lib/scoring.test.ts

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] calculateResult thresholds match source (>3.5 high, <2.5 low)
- [ ] scoreAnswers returns all five domains even with missing answers

**Verify:** npm test -> scoring tests pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/scoring.ts", "src/lib/scoring.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["thresholds correct", "all five domains always returned"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Character roster and trait content
tasks.description:
**Goal:** 20 curated characters with OCEAN profiles and original blurbs, 10 per-trait notes, 5 trait descriptions.

**Files:**
- Create: src/data/characters.ts, src/data/traitNotes.ts, src/data/traitInfo.ts
- Test: src/data/characters.test.ts, src/data/traitNotes.test.ts, src/data/traitInfo.test.ts

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] >=20 characters, unique ids, profile values 0-100
- [ ] Original blurbs, no verbatim quotes
- [ ] One trait note and one trait info per domain

**Verify:** npm test -> content tests pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/data/characters.ts", "src/data/traitNotes.ts", "src/data/traitInfo.ts", "src/data/characters.test.ts", "src/data/traitNotes.test.ts", "src/data/traitInfo.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": [">=20 characters", "unique ids", "one note/info per domain"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Matching algorithm
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Nearest-neighbor match from normalized scores to the character roster.

**Files:**
- Create: src/lib/matching.ts
- Test: src/lib/matching.test.ts

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Returns smallest-distance roster entry
- [ ] Stable tie-break (first roster entry wins)
- [ ] Throws on empty roster

**Verify:** npm test -> matching tests pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/matching.ts", "src/lib/matching.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["nearest match correct", "stable tie-break", "throws on empty roster"]}
```
